title: LISTEN TO THIS POWERFUL PRAYER THIS NIGHT WHILE YOU SLEEP GOD WILL TOUCH YOU TONIGHT
text: Glory be to God in the highest. I want you to understand something this evening. There is a dimension of divine encounter that heaven releases when men settle their hearts before the presence of God. The Bible says in Psalm 48, I will both lay me down in peace and sleep, for thou Lord only makst me dwell in safety. This is not just a poetic expression. This is a prophetic declaration over the life of every believer who understands the realm of rest in God. You see, the enemy understands that your sleep is not just a physical activity. Sleep is a spiritual arena. It is in the realm of sleep that destinies are tampered with, that covenants are established, that words are spoken into the subconscious, and that foundations are either built or destroyed. The Bible says in Job 33:15-16, "In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep fallth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed, then he openeth the ears of men and sealeth their instruction." God speaks to men in their sleep. But I want you to know that the enemy also seeks access to that realm. Tonight, God wants to touch you. He wants to restore your sleep. He wants to give you peace that passes understanding. But more than that, he wants to sanctify your sleep. He wants to turn your sleep into an altar of encounter where you meet with him in dreams and visions. There are people who have not slept peacefully in months, in years. There are those who close their eyes and see terrible images. There are those who wake up more tired than when they went to bed. Tonight is your night of divine visitation. I decree over your life right now. Every spiritual manipulation that has turned your sleep into a battlefield, I command it to seize in the name of Jesus. Every covenant that has been established in the dream realm against your destiny, I nullify it by the blood of Jesus. Every satanic programmer that has been assigned to your sleep, I command that spirit to be bound and cast into the abies in the mighty name of Jesus. The word of God declares in Proverbs 3:24, "When the Father, I come before your throne of grace with holy hands lifted up without rough or doubting, I come on behalf of every soul hearing the sound of my voice. every person watching, every person listening, everyone who will encounter this word in days, weeks, months, and years to come. Lord, I ask that you meet them at the point of their need tonight. The Bible says in Matthew 11:28, "Come unto me all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest." Father, give them rest. Give them peace. Give them sleep that restores. Sleep that refreshes. Sleep that positions them for the next day's assignment. I take authority over every spirit of insomnia. I bind you in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of fear that torments people at night. Every spirit of anxiety that keeps their minds racing when they should be resting. Every spirit of depression that weighs heavy on their souls when darkness falls, I command you to loose your hold and come out in the name of Jesus. I declare that where the spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty. I prophesy liberty over your sleep. I prophesy freedom over your night. I prophesy peace over your pillow by the power of the Holy Ghost. I decree that every evil monitoring spirit assigned to watch you while you sleep is rendered blind and deaf right now in the name of Jesus. The Bible says in Psalm 121:4, "Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. If God does not sleep, why should his children be tormented in their sleep? I decree that the eyes of the Lord that never sleep are watching over you. I decree angelic protection around your bed. I decree that your bedroom becomes a sanctuary, a place of peace, a place of rest, a place where heaven touches earth. Thus sayeth the spirit of the living God. There is someone under the sound of my voice who has been battling with nightmares. You go to bed afraid. You sleep with lights on. You wake up in the middle of the night with your heart racing. The Lord says to you tonight, I am breaking that cycle. Let me pray with authority now. Every evil dedication that was done over your life as a child that has given the enemy access to your sleep, I revoke it by the blood of Jesus. Every ancestral covenant that has opened doors for nighttime affliction, I break it by fire. Every cause spoken over your family line concerning sleepless nights, concerning torment, concerning fear, I reverse it in the mighty name of Jesus. I command every evil spiritual transaction that was done in the second heaven affecting your peace at night to be nullified right now by the blood of the lamb. Father, I ask that you arise with healing in your wings. The Bible says in Malachi 4:2, "But unto you that fear my name shall the son of righteousness arise with healing in his wings." I prophesy healing over troubled minds tonight. I prophesy healing over anxious hearts. I prophesy healing over bodies that are exhausted, that are weary, that are worn out from lack of rest. I speak to every organ, every tissue, every cell, every system in your body and I command restoration. I command renewal. I command strength to return by the authority vested in me as a minister of the gospel and an ambassador of heaven. I decree and declare that your sleep tonight shall be prophetic. God shall visit you. He shall speak to you. He shall give you instructions. He shall give you insight. He shall give you wisdom for the challenges you are facing. The Bible says in Daniel 2:22, "He revealth the deep and secret things. He knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him." I prophesy that God shall reveal secrets to you in your sleep. He shall show you things to come. He shall give you strategies and solutions. I come against every spirit husband and every spirit wife that has been tormenting people in their sleep. I command you to lose your hold right now in the name of Jesus. Every marriage that has been under attack in the dream realm, I decree restoration. Every person who has been experiencing spiritual rape in their dreams, I declare your deliverance tonight. I bind every incub spirit. I bind every succubus spirit. I command you to come out and never let fire fall right now. Let the fire of the Holy Ghost consume every evil plantation in the life of everyone hearing my voice. Let the fire burn away every mark, every label, every identification that the enemy has put on you to track you, to monitor you, to torment you. I decree that you are hidden in Christ. I decree that all things have passed away. I decree that all things have become new. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 5:17, "Therefore, if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature. Old things are passed away. Behold, all things have become new. I speak to your mind right now. Mind, receive the peace of God. Thoughts, align with the word of God. Imagination be sanctified by the blood of Jesus. Memory release every traumatic image, every painful experience, every tormenting recollection that has been disturbing your peace at night. I command healing for your mind in the name of Jesus. The Bible says in Isaiah 26:3, "Thou will keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on thee because he trusted in thee." I decree perfect peace over your mind. Tonight, Father, I pray for those battling with physical pain that keeps them awake at night. I speak to every form of pain right now. Pain in the head, pain in the back, pain in the joints, pain in the chest, pain in the abdomen, pain anywhere in the body. I command you to seize in the name of Jesus. Let the healing power of God flow through every part of their body. Let restoration come. Let wholeness manifest. The Bible declares in 1 Peter 2:24, "By whose stripes ye were healed, that healing has already been purchased, I decree that it manifest now in the mighty name of Jesus." I take authority over every spirit of worry and care that has been stealing people's sleep. The Bible says in 1 Peter 5:7, "Casting all your care upon him, for he carth for you." Father, I ask that you teach your children how to cast their cares on you. Teach them how to trust you. Teach them how to rest in your faithfulness. I decree that every burden is lifted tonight. Every weight is removed. Every heavy load is taken off. There is someone here who has been battling with sleep apneoa, with breathing problems at night. The Lord says to you, I am your breath. I am the one who gives you life. I command every breathing passage to open right now in the name of Jesus. I speak to your lungs. I speak to your airways. I command normal function. I command healing. I command restoration. Breathe freely. Sleep peacefully. Wake up refreshed in the mighty name of Jesus. By the blood of Jesus, I decree protection over your household tonight. I decree that the angel of the Lord encamps around your dwelling place. I decree that no evil shall befall you. Neither shall any plague come near your dwelling. The word of God in Psalm 91:10 says, "There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling. I stand on that word tonight and I decree it over every home, every bedroom, every sleeping space represented here. Let me address something in the realm of the spirit. There are evil altars where your names are being mentioned at night. There are covens where assignments are being given against your peace. There are witchcraft gatherings where incantations are being made to disturb your sleep and torment your life. I want you to know that you are not at the mercy of these forces. The Bible says in Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shall condemn. I decree that every weapon formed against you fails. I decree that every evil tongue speaking against you is silenced. I return every arrow of the enemy to the sender. Every evil projection sent into your life through witchcraft, through sorcery, through divination, I command it to return to the sender sevenfold in the name of Jesus. Let every evil altar erected against you catch fire right now. Let divine fire consume every shrine where your name is mentioned for evil. Let angelic warriors invade every gathering of darkness assigned against your destiny. I decree confusion in the camp of the enemy. I decree that their plans backfire. I decree that their schemes collapse. Father, I pray for families tonight. There are homes where nobody sleeps peacefully because of spiritual warfare. There are parents who stay awake all night worried about their children. There are children who cry at night because of demonic torment. Lord, I ask that you visit such homes. I ask that you bring peace. I ask that you bring healing. I ask that you bring deliverance. Let your presence fill every room. Let your glory manifest in every corner. Let every family member experience divine rest tonight in the mighty name of Jesus. I take authority over every stronghold of fear. Fear of darkness, fear of being alone, fear of sleeping, fear of not waking up, fear of what might happen while you sleep. I bind all these fears in the name of Jesus. The Bible says in 2 Timothy 1:7, "For God had not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." I decree that you receive power. Tonight, I decree that you receive love that cast out fear. I decree that you receive a sound mind that is not tormented, that is not troubled, that is at peace. Thus, sayeth the Lord, I am giving you back your nights. What the enemy has stolen two years of torment, two years of sleeplessness, two years of nightmares, I am restoring tonight. Your night shall become productive. Your sleep shall become sweet. Your dreams shall become prophetic. You shall lay down and sleep and wake up refreshed because I, the Lord, sustain you. Stand on that word. Believe that word. Receive that word into your spirit right now. I speak to every person struggling with guilt and condemnation that keeps them awake at night. The accuser of the brethren speaks loudest in the night season. He reminds you of your past. He brings up your failures. He condemns you with your mistakes. But I want you to know what the word says in Romans 8:1. There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the spirit. If you are in Christ, you are not condemned. I decree that the voice of the accuser is silenced over your life. I decree that you hear only the voice of the father who says, "You are forgiven. You are loved. You are accepted. You are mine." By fire, by force, I break every cycle of generational insomnia. If your parents did not sleep, if your grandparents battled with sleeplessness, if this is a family pattern, I break it right now in the name of Jesus. I decree that the cycle ends with you. I decree that your children and your children's children shall sleep peacefully. I decree that rest is restored to your bloodline. I decree that peace becomes your family inheritance. Father, I ask for angelic ministry tonight. The Bible says in Hebrews 1:14, "Are they not all ministering spirits? Send forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation? Lord, dispatch your angels. Let them stand guard over your people tonight. Let them minister peace. Let them minister protection. Let them minister healing. Let them minister deliverance. Let them minister rest. I decree that angels are assigned to every person hearing my voice right now. I speak to the atmosphere over your region, every territorial spirit that has been assigned to bring restlessness, to bring fear, to bring torment over your city, over your community, over your neighborhood. I bind you in the name of Jesus. I decree that you have no authority. I decree that you have no power. I decree that you are bound and rendered ineffective. I release the peace of God over the atmosphere. I release the presence of God over the region. I decree that the kingdom of God is established. Let me pray for those who work night shifts, who have to stay awake at night. Father, I ask that you give them grace. I ask that you give them strength. I ask that when they do sleep during the day, their sleep shall be quality sleep, restorative sleep, peaceful sleep. I decree protection over them as they walk through the night. I decree alertness when they need to be alert. I decree rest when they need to rest. I decree that their bodies adjust supernaturally to their schedules without harm, without damage, without negative consequences by the authority of the word of God. I decree and declare that your sleep positions you for the next level of your destiny. The Bible speaks about Jacob who slept and dreamt and saw angels ascending and descending. That sleep changed his life. That dream repositioned him. Tonight your sleep shall be strategic. Your dreams shall be prophetic. God shall use your night season to prepare you for your day season. I decree divine preparation. I decree spiritual positioning. I decree prophetic alignment. I come against every spirit of depression that increases at night. There are people who are fine during the day, but when night comes, darkness settles on their souls. That is not natural. That is a spiritual attack. I bind that spirit right now in the name of Jesus. I decree that the joy of the Lord is your strength. Even at night, I decree that the peace of God guards your heart and mind even in darkness. I decree that the presence of God surrounds you even when you are alone. The word says in Psalm 30:5, "Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning. I accelerate your morning. I decree that your night season is shortened and your morning of joy arrives speedily." Father, I lift up to you those who are battling with addictions, to sleeping pills, to drugs, to alcohol, using these substances to find sleep. Lord, I ask that you deliver them. I ask that you break the chains. I ask that you set them free. I decree supernatural sleep without dependency on any substance. I decree that their bodies are healed from the effects of these substances. I decree that their natural sleep patterns are restored. The Bible says in John 8:36, "If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed." I prophesy freedom tonight, complete freedom, total freedom, permanent freedom. I speak to the parents of young children who are not sleeping because their babies are not sleeping. Father, I ask that you touch those children. I ask that you give them peaceful sleep. I ask that you give their parents rest. I decree that colleague is healed. I decree that discomfort is removed. I decree that fear in children is cast out. I decree that the whole household sleeps peacefully. I speak to children. Let fire fall on every evil dream programmer. Let fire fall on every satanic sleep manipulator. Let fire fall on every demonic coordinator assigned to the night season of believers. I decree that they are consumed by the fire of God. I decree that their assignments fail. I decree that their plans are frustrated. I decree that their works are destroyed. The Bible says in Exodus 15:7, "In the greatness of thine excellency, thou has overthrown them that rose up against thee, thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consume them as stubble. I take authority over the spirit of Lilith, the queen of the night. I bind you and all demons under your command. I break every covenant you have with any life represented here. I revoke every dedication made to you. I nullify every sacrifice offered to you. I decree that you have no claim, no right, no access to any child of God. By the blood of Jesus, I close every door. By the blood of Jesus, I seal every entrance. By the blood of Jesus, I establish divine protection. Father, I pray for married couples whose marriages are under attack at night. There are couples who fight at night. There are couples who cannot sleep in the same bed. There are couples whose intimacy has been destroyed by spiritual warfare. Lord, I ask that you heal these marriages. I ask that you restore love. I ask that you restore peace. I ask that you restore unity. I decree that what God has joined together, no demon of hell can put us under. I decree that the bedroom becomes a place of love, of peace, of harmony, of blessing. I decree deliverance for those who sleepwalk. I decree healing for those who talk in their sleep and reveal information that should be kept private. I decree freedom for those whose bodies do things at night that they have no control over. Whatever is not normal, whatever is not of God, whatever is demonic activity manifesting through your body at night, I command it to stop right now in the name of Jesus. I decree that you have full control over your body. I decree that your sleep is peaceful and still by the power of the blood of Jesus. I decree that your pillow becomes an altar of encounter. The place where you lay your head becomes a place where God speaks, where God visits, where God ministers. I anoint your pillow right now by faith. I anoint your bed by faith. I anoint your bedroom by faith. I decree that these are holy spaces, consecrated spaces, sanctified spaces, protected spaces. No demon can enter, no evil can penetrate. Only the presence of God dwells there. Thus sayeth the spirit of the living God. What I am doing tonight is not just for tonight. I am establishing a pattern. I am setting a standard. I am creating a new normal from tonight going forward. Your night shall be different. Your sleep shall be different. Your dreams shall be different. You are entering a new season of rest, a new season of peace, a new season of divine encounter at night. I speak life to your pineal gland. I speak life to your hypothalamus. I speak life to every part of your brain that regulates sleep. I decree normal function. I decree divine function. I decree that your body produces what it needs to produce for you to sleep naturally. I decree balance in your hormones. I decree balance in your chemistry. I decree that everything that was out of order comes into divine order right now in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, I pray for those who are in hospitals tonight. Those who are in pain, those who cannot sleep because of their medical conditions. Lord, touch them, heal them, comfort them, give them peace even in their pain. Give them rest even in their discomfort. Minister to them in their night watches. Let them know that you are with them, that you have not forgotten them, that you are working all things together for their good. The word says in Psalm 4:8, "I will both lay me down in peace and sleep, for thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety. I decree that even in the hospital they dwell in safety. Even in pain they have peace. Even in discomfort, I take authority over every spirit of restlessness. I bind you in the name of Jesus. Every spirit that causes tossing and turning, every spirit that causes legs to shake and bodies to move involuntarily at night, I command you to come out and never return. I decree stillness. I decree peace. I decree rest. The Bible says in Mark 4:39, "And he arose and rebuked the wind and said unto the sea, peace be still." And the wind seized, and there was a great calm. I speak that same word over your life tonight. Peace be still. Let there be a great calm in your body, in your mind, in your spirit, in your emotions. By divine authority, I scatter every evil gathering that has been summoned against you. I scatter every coven meeting. I scatter every witchcraft circle. I scatter every satanic council. I decree confusion in their midst. I decree that they cannot agree. I decree that their plans cannot stand. I decree that their works cannot prosper. The word of God says in Psalm 35:4, "Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul. Let them be turned back and brought to confusion that divides my heart. I decree confusion to the camp of the enemy tonight." Let me pray for revelation and understanding. Father, there are people who need wisdom. There are people who need insight. There are people who need divine strategies. The Bible says you give to your beloved even in their sleep. I ask that you visit them tonight. Give them dreams that bring solutions. Give them visions that bring clarity. Give them divine downloads that bring breakthrough. Let them wake up tomorrow with answers they did not have today. Let them wake up with understanding they did not possess before. Let them wake up with strategies from heaven. I decree restoration of sleep that has been stolen. Some of you have lost years of good sleep. Some of you cannot remember the last time you slept through the night. Some of you have forgotten what it feels like to wake up refreshed. Tonight, God is restoring what was stolen. He is giving back what the enemy took. The Bible says in Joel 2:25, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten. I prophesy restoration." Father, I pray for students who are anxious about exams, about their future, about their education. I pray for business people who are worried about their finances, about their companies, about their investments. I pray for those who are concerned about their health, about their families, about their relationships. Lord, teach them to trust you. Teach them to rest in you. Teach them that worry adds nothing. The Bible says in Matthew 6:27, "Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?" I decree that anxiety is replaced with faith. I decree that worry is replaced with trust. I decree that fear is replaced with confidence in God. By the authority of heaven, I uproot every evil tree planted in your life through the dream realm. Every seed that was sold while you slept, every covenant that was established while you were unconscious, every mark that was placed on you in the spiritual realm, I uproot it right now by the blood of Jesus. I decree that only what God has planted remains. I decree that everything else is pulled up by the roots and cast into the fire. The word says in Matthew 15:13, "Every plant which my heavenly father had not planted shall be rooted up. Let it be done now in the mighty name of Jesus. I speak peace to troubled homes. Homes where there is fighting, where there is strife, where there is chaos. I decree that peace enters tonight. I decree that the presence of God fills every room. I decree that love is restored. I decree that harmony returns. I decree that every member of the household sleeps peacefully. The Bible says in Colossians 3:15, "And let the peace of God rule in your hearts. I decree that peace rules, that peace reigns, that peace dominates in every home represented here tonight. Let fire fall on every evil monitoring gadget in the spiritual realm. Let fire fall on every satanic surveillance system tracking your movements in the dream world. Let fire fall on every demonic recording device capturing your conversations in your sleep. I decree that they are all consumed by the fire of God. I decree that you are invisible to the enemy. I decree that Father, I pray for those battling with guilt from past sins. The enemy uses the night to amplify their shame. He uses darkness to magnify their regrets. But I decree that the blood of Jesus speaks better things. I decree that where sin abounded, grace does much more abound. I decree that if God has forgiven, they must forgive themselves. I decree that they are new creatures in Christ. I decree that old things have passed away and all things have become new. The word says in 1 John 1:9, "If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. I decree cleansing. I decree freedom. I decree peace tonight. I take authority over every satanic network connected to your life. I disconnect you from every evil system. I separate you from every dark matrix. I cut every cord that the enemy has used to drain your energy, to steal your peace, to torment your sleep. By the sword of the spirit, I cut you loose. By the blood of Jesus, I set you free. By the fire of God, I seal your deliverance. You are no longer connected to darkness. You are connected to light. You are connected to life. You are connected to God by prophetic declaration. I decree that your bedroom becomes a throne room. It becomes a place where the presence of God dwells. It becomes a place where angels minister. It becomes a place where heaven touches earth. I decree that when you enter your bedroom, you enter into rest. When you close your door, you shut out the world and shut in the peace of God. When you lay on your bed, you lay in the shadow of the Almighty. Let me address sleep disorders. Sleep apneoa, insomnia, nlepsy, restless leg syndrome, whatever medical name has been given to your sleep problem. I speak healing right now. I command normal sleep patterns. I command restoration of natural rhythms. I command divine healing. The Bible says in Exodus 15:26, "I am the Lord that health thee." I decree that the Lord heals you tonight. Not partially, not gradually, but completely, suddenly, supernaturally.
